title: 临江仙·夜归临皋
titlePy: Lín Jiāng Xiān · Yè Guī Língāo
titleEn: Immortal by the River: Coming Home at Night to Lingao
author: 苏轼
intro: Home late and tipsy, Su Shi finds his servant snoring and the door shut. So he leans on his stick, listens to the river — and dreams of drifting away in a small boat for the rest of his life.
analysis: 这首词写苏轼在黄州的一个夜晚。上阕写一件生活小事：夜里在东坡喝酒，醒了又醉，回到家好像已经三更了。看门的小童睡得正香，鼾声像打雷一样，怎么敲门都没人答应，他只好拄着拐杖，站在门外听江水的声音。被关在门外本来是件尴尬事，诗人却不着急，反而静静听起江声来，很有趣味。下阕写由江声引起的思考：常常遗憾这个身子不属于自己（“此身非我有”出自《庄子》），什么时候才能忘掉那些忙忙碌碌的追求呢？夜深了，风停了，江面的波纹平平的。不如乘一只小船从此离去，在江海上度过余生。他当然没有真的走，但这几句写出了一个被名利和官场束缚的人，对自由的深深向往。
analysisEn: One night in Huangzhou. The first half is a small, real-life scene. Su Shi has been drinking at Dongpo, his farm plot — sober, then drunk again — and gets home around midnight. His boy servant is fast asleep, snoring like thunder; no amount of knocking gets an answer. So he leans on his stick and listens to the river. Being locked out could be annoying, but he doesn’t fuss; he just stands and listens, which is the charm of it. The second half follows where the sound of the river leads. He has long regretted that “this body is not my own” — a phrase from the Taoist book Zhuangzi: his life is tied up by duty, office and ambition. When can he forget all that busy striving? The night is late, the wind has dropped, the ripples on the water are smooth as silk. Why not slip away in a little boat and spend the rest of his days on rivers and seas? He never actually left, of course. But these lines voice the longing of anyone tied down by career and obligation for a life that is truly free. A story says that next day the rumour spread that Su Shi had sailed off, and the local governor rushed over — to find him still snoring at home.
background: Su Shi (1037–1101) wrote this in 1082 in Huangzhou, where he lived in exile at Lingao, a riverside lodging, and farmed a slope he called “East Slope” (Dongpo) — the source of his famous name.
pronunciation: 醒 xǐng；更 gēng（三更）；应 yìng（答应）；倚 yǐ；縠 hú（有皱纹的纱，不读 gǔ）；皋 gāo。
version: 采用通行版本（与维基文库《东坡词》主文一致）。异文：家童一作“家僮”，已雷鸣一作“若雷鸣”，倚杖一作“久立”，何时一作“何曾”，夜阑一作“夜来”，小舟一作“扁舟”，从此逝一作“从此去”。

lines.py: yè yǐn dōng pō xǐng fù zuì
lines.lit: Drinking at night at East Slope, sober and drunk again,
lines.en: Drinking at East Slope tonight, sobering up, then drunk again,

lines.py: guī lái fǎng fú sān gēng
lines.lit: I come home at what seems the third watch.
lines.en: I get home, it must be near midnight.

lines.py: jiā tóng bí xī yǐ léi míng
lines.lit: The house boy’s breathing already thunders.
lines.en: The boy is snoring like thunder.

lines.lit: Knocking at the door, no one answers;
lines.en: I knock, and no one answers,

lines.lit: leaning on my staff, I listen to the river’s sound.
lines.en: so I lean on my stick and listen to the river.

lines.py: cháng hèn cǐ shēn fēi wǒ yǒu
lines.lit: I long regret that this body is not my own;
lines.en: How I hate that this life is not my own —

lines.py: hé shí wàng què yíng yíng
lines.lit: when will I forget the busy striving?
lines.en: when can I forget all this restless chasing?

lines.py: yè lán fēng jìng hú wén píng
lines.lit: The night is late, the wind still, the silk-like ripples flat.
lines.en: Late night, no wind, the ripples smooth as silk.

lines.lit: In a small boat, from here I would depart;
lines.en: I’ll take a little boat and drift away from here,

lines.lit: to rivers and seas I would entrust the rest of my life.
lines.en: and give what’s left of my life to the rivers and the sea.

words.en: Lingao, Su Shi’s riverside lodging in Huangzhou
East Slope, the land Su Shi farmed
words.note: 苏轼在黄州开垦的荒地，他因此自号“东坡居士”。
现代汉语“反复”“重复”的“复”。
现代汉语也常用，意思“好像”。
古代把夜晚分为五更；现代汉语“半夜三更”。
现代汉语“仰人鼻息”还用。

words.en: this body is not my own

words.note: 现代汉语“营营役役”“蝇营狗苟”还有类似说法。
阑：将尽。现代汉语“夜阑人静”。
縠：有皱纹的纱，比喻水面的细波。
现代汉语多指“去世”“消逝”。

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 醒了又醉，写出诗人在贬谪中借酒排遣，也很随性。
imagery.en: Sober, then drunk again: wine helps him through exile, and shows his easy-going mood.

imagery.name: 江
imagery.zh: 江声让人安静下来，引出对人生的思考；平静的江面也象征心灵的宁静。
imagery.en: The river’s sound quiets him and starts his reflection; its calm surface mirrors a calm mind.

imagery.name: 孤舟
imagery.zh: 小舟代表离开官场、自由自在的生活。
imagery.en: The little boat stands for escape from official life into freedom.
